title: Guess the Number
description:
```
I'm thinking of a number 1-100. You have 7 guesses.
Guess #1: 50
Too high!
Guess #2: 25
Too low!
...
Guess #5: 37
Correct! You got it in 5 guesses.
Play again? (y/n):
```
hints: Keep a `bool won{ false };` outside the loop. Set it and `break` when the guess is right; after the loop, `if (!won)` reveals the number.

For "play again", wrap everything after creating `rng` in a `do { ... } while (getYesNo());`, where `getYesNo` reads a `char` and returns `c == 'y'`. Create the random engine only once, before the loop.
stretch: difficulty levels (range & tries), and a "computer guesses YOUR number" mode using binary search.
